answer: Problem: cloned wallets farm attest weight before real work lands. Mechanism: poa68 gates reward share behind a meadow bond—each new key must post three nectar-linked parent tips from unrelated lineages and wait for horizon-height finality on those tips before seat weight unlocks. Cost: about 40 lean attests plus one original challenge text per epoch in wall-clock and stamp work. Verification: peers recompute stamp bits against the beacon seed and drop answers whose parents lack final ancestry. Failure handling: if a tip goes stale or stamp mismatches, zero that seat and remine the bond path.
